overrides_applied.reason: DATA_GAP:sbc — SBC missing for FY2023, FY2024, FY2025 under every tag the engine reads, because Erie has no equity-settled share-based compensation to subtract. Note 11: 'We do not issue new shares of common stock to satisfy plan awards' (ECP) / 'to settle stock awards' (LTIP) / 'to directors' (deferred stock plan) — every share-linked award is settled in cash or with Class A shares purchased on the open market (treasury/rabbi-trust shares), the open LTIP performance periods (2023-2025, 2024-2026, 2025-2027) are all payable in cash, and the costs are liability-accrued compensation already inside operating expenses. The cash-flow statement is direct-method (cash receipts minus cash paid, fully enumerated for FY2023-FY2025 with no SBC addback or non-cash compensation line), so the compensation cost already sits inside reported OCF — subtracting an SBC figure again would double-count it (same treatment as COKE/SQM/LTM in this sweep). The filing-proven equity-settled SBC figure for the gap years is $0.

overrides_applied.source: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-23, accession 0001628280-26-010666), Consolidated Statements of Operations and Note 5, Earnings Per Share: weighted average shares outstanding — Diluted, Class A common stock 52,305,424 for FY2025 (52,306,266 FY2024; 52,299,411 FY2023); Class A diluted EPS $10.69 on total net income $559,335 thousand under the if-converted method (52,305,424 x $10.69 = total net income, i.e. this denominator carries the whole company's earnings including the Class B allocation).
overrides_applied.reason: DATA_GAP:shares — diluted shares missing for FY2023, FY2024, FY2025 in companyfacts because the filer tags share counts only by share class (the only undimensioned WeightedAverageNumberOfDilutedSharesOutstanding fact in companyfacts is the 2,542-share Class B count). The filer's own FY2025 Class A diluted weighted-average count — computed under the if-converted method, i.e. including assumed conversion of the 2,542 Class B shares (2,400:1 = 6,100,800 Class A equivalents) and the dilutive effect of stock-based awards (15,600 shares) — fills the gap. The engine applies this single value to every missing period; the filer's own FY2024/FY2023 diluted counts (52,306,266 / 52,299,411) differ from it by less than 0.02%, so no year's OE/share is materially moved.
